findings.message: 18 CYCL DEF 200 DRILLING ~: this cycle is called at a position (CYCL CALL POS, line 30), whose Z adds to the surface coordinate of the cycle, so a Z shift would move the cycle twice; a shift in X and Y alone can be made.
20 CYCL CALL POS X+40 Y+40 Z+0 FMAX: the Z of a cycle call at a position adds to the surface coordinate of the cycle, so a Z shift would move the cycle twice; a shift in X and Y alone can be made.
25 L Z-5 R0 FMAX M91: a position in machine coordinates or an incremental return to the reference point; left as written.
